unit: One changed next-token choice under the same recorded input prefix
reviewer: Root AI reviewer; independent of the second AI review, not human annotation

labels.F: Local formatting only: whitespace or capitalization with no apparent content change in the available context. Punctuation is not automatically harmless.
labels.W: Local wording or grammatical alternative with no explicit change of propositional content established by this prefix; not a claim of strict equivalence.
labels.C: Potential change of content, fact, named entity, number, reference, tense or specificity supported by the visible prefix and candidates.
labels.L: Explicit polarity, negation or logical-relation change identifiable from the visible prefix and candidates; record whether a definite reversal is established.
labels.U: Insufficient information to distinguish alternatives reliably, including fragments whose unknown continuation determines their meaning.

rules: Read all 100 selected samples; do not replace difficult examples.
Read the full available model prefix when a short tail is ambiguous.
Reference Top-1 is a comparator, not a correctness label.
Do not construct a purported generated continuation by appending the original suffix to either candidate.
A change of punctuation, article or pronoun is not automatically semantically equivalent.
Use U when unknown continuation materially prevents a defensible category; do not mechanically label every subword U.
Classify a visible logical change as L only with a concrete explanation; otherwise classify a supported content change as C.
Confidence describes confidence in the category, not confidence in model correctness.
The result characterizes local token choices on natural-text prefixes, not downstream answer accuracy or completed reasoning trajectories.
Do not read the other reviewer's annotations until this review is saved.
